# Pubgolf

> Pubgolf (pubgolf.eu) turns a pub crawl into a game: every bar is a hole, your phone is the scorecard and the lowest score wins. Ready-made routes in 12 European cities, for 2 to 12 players in 2 to 6 teams. 18+. A game, not a drinking contest: alcohol-free drinks count the same.

- Price: €5 per group (introductory price, later €10). One game code for the whole group, sent by email. Erasmus students play for free until 31 January 2027 (code via Instagram DM @pubgolf.eu).
- How it works: book a city, date and start time; open the link on your phones (no app); walk the route; along the way special holes, a city quiz, photo challenges and a casino alarm every 45 minutes.
- Groups larger than 12 (company events, bachelor parties): several groups with staggered starts on one live leaderboard.
- Operated by ForkitLeiden. Contact: bookings@forkit.nl. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pubgolf.eu/

## Cities
- [Pubgolf Milan](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/milan/): 18 holes
- [Pubgolf Amsterdam](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/amsterdam/): 15 holes
- [Pubgolf Barcelona](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/barcelona/): 15 holes
- [Pubgolf Prague](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/prague/): 18 holes
- [Pubgolf Dublin](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/dublin/): 13 holes
- [Pubgolf Lisboa](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/lisbon/): 14 holes
- [Pubgolf Budapest](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/budapest/): 18 holes
- [Pubgolf Kraków](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/krakow/): 15 holes
- [Pubgolf València](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/valencia/): 16 holes
- [Pubgolf København](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/copenhagen/): 15 holes
- [Pubgolf Leiden](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/leiden/): 13 holes
- [Pubgolf Madrid](https://pubgolf.eu/en/cities/madrid/): 18 holes
